verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a SaaS code-review product that processes customer code, so the axis applies. The privacy page only documents no third-party model training and the option to block AI features for a workspace. Those are adjacent privacy controls, not user-controllable retention periods or data deletion, and the pack documents no retention settings, deletion requests or data purge capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
